title: The 13 grow: the carried link lies outside the top's component
claim: Lemma J: a bond lies in one component. Theorem G on the component of level k: if every saturated composite of l0 steps along joined children is a product, L_N(k, s) >= (floor(n/l0) + 3)/2. For the 5 distinct patterns among the 13 mutants of 8db5da810c00: the self-similar subtrees are joined to their parents by no knot (separate components; at depth 11 none of 3,512 self-similar addresses shares a component with level 3), and on the top's component l0 = 5, so L_N(3, s) >= (floor((s-1)/5) + 3)/2 at every depth: linear growth. The joined product test agrees with forgetting on all 786 census descriptions and passes exactly the 13 of the 39; all 2,380 fresh and mutated small-orbit descriptions of KEEP-REACH are decided. Referee pending.
